title: Console activation sequence and customer-facing messaging for FinOps & cost-anomaly dashboard
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Coordinate a staged activation and external communications for the new FinOps dashboard and cost-anomaly alerting feature. Deliverables: 1) release notes and customer-facing copy tailored to three personas (FinOps engineer, product engineer, platform admin); 2) a staged activation plan (alpha -> beta -> GA) with gating criteria and rollback steps; 3) internal enablement materials (playbook, short recorded demos, a one-pager and a troubleshooting runbook); 4) training schedule for Solutions Engineering and CS; 5) localization plan for EN/FR/DE.

Success metrics: - 80% of early-beta customers enable the dashboard within 2 weeks of invite - <3 critical bugs reported in first 30 days - Training: 90% of SEs complete the 30-minute module and pass the quick quiz - Cost visibility: median time-to-insight for an anomalous bill drops by 40% for beta cohort.

Key launch decisions to make in this ticket: - Activation gating: require backend anomaly detection model A/B performance >= baseline precision/recall (ENG to supply metrics) - Default on vs opt-in: opt-in for Starter orgs, default-on for Dedicated customers with notification and opt-out flow - Rollout cadence: 50 orgs/day after initial green signal, with capacity throttle in Console if capacity > 75%.

Release notes snippet (short): "FinOps Dashboard — track usage and cost trends across models and regions, receive automated cost-anomaly alerts, and drill into per-route token breakdowns. Beta: invite-only. Learn more: [link]."

Supported artifacts to attach: roadmap PRD, UX spec, sample alerts library, demo scripts, eval dashboard links. Owners: PM (Priya), Eng lead (Miguel Torres), Design lead (Liam O'Rourke).
